name: Widar 3.0 WiFi-Based Activity Recognition Dataset
description: Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI) dataset for cross-domain human gesture recognition, including CSI, Doppler frequency shift, and body-coordinate velocity profile data.
citation: Yue Zheng, Yi Zhang, Guidong Zhang, Kun Qian, Yunhao Liu, Chenshu Wu, and Zheng Yang. ‘Zero-Effort Cross-Domain Gesture Recognition With Wi-Fi.’ Proceedings of the 17th Annual International Conference on Mobile Systems, Applications, and Services (MobiSys 2019).
